data.name: Kaleema
data.gender_notes: Kaleema is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who speaks the truth, or the one who is pure and sincere. The name Kaleema carries the meaning “Speaker of Truth” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Kaleema usually hope their child will grow to embody speaker of truth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Refers to a person who speaks the truth and lives a truthful life, following the teachings of Islam.
data.etymology: Kaleema belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Speaker of Truth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kaleema total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: كاليمة
in_arabic.meaning: كلمة تعني كلام أو قول أو لسان
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة كلام، يعني القول أو الكلام، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَكَلِمَةُ اللَّهِ هِيَ الْعُلْيَا'، وتستخدم هذه الكلمة في الثقافة الإسلامية لتعبر عن اللسان أو الكلام الذي يعبّر عن الإيمان والتوحيد.

in_urdu.name: کلیما
in_urdu.long_meaning: علم نام ایک خوبصورت اور اہم نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے کلام یا قول، اور یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں اہم کردار رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر قرآن کی آیات میں جہاں کلمہ اللہ کا ذکر ہے، یہ نام اسلامی روایات میں زبان یا کلام کی علامت ہے جو عقیدہ اور توحید کا اظہار کرتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: कलीमा
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह एक सुंदर और महत्वपूर्ण नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है बातचीत या बोलचाल, और यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है, खासकर कुरआन की आयतों में जहां अल्लाह की कلمة का उल्लेख है, यह नाम मुस्लिम परंपराओं में जीभ या बोलचाल का प्रतीक है जो विश्वास और एकेश্বরवाद को व्यक्त करती है।

in_pashto.name: کالیما
in_pashto.long_meaning: دغه نوم د پښتو ژبې د يوې مهمې او ښکلي نوم دی، چې د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، او ددې مطلب دی خبرې اتر یا کلام، او دا نوم د پښتنو په کلتور کې مهم رول لوبوي، په ځانګړي ډول د قرانکریم په آیتونو کې چې د کلمہ الله ذکر دی، دا نوم د مسلمانو په دودونو کې د ژبې یا کلام نښه ده چې ایمان او توحید څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Kaleema
in_english.long_meaning: Kaleema is a beautiful and significant name derived from Arabic roots, specifically meaning speech, word, or tongue, it has deep Quranic connections, notably in phrases like 'Kalimatullah' (Word of God), symbolizing faith and monotheism in Islamic tradition, historically used across Muslim cultures, reflecting linguistic and spiritual importance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kaleema in Islamic culture is often associated with sincerity and truthfulness. It carries a profound meaning as it literally translates to "one who speaks the truth." In various Middle Eastern societies, the name is given to children with the hope that they will grow up to be truthful and sincere individuals.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Kaleema lies in its connection to inner purity and sincerity towards God. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) once said, "Verily, truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to paradise." By carrying the name Kaleema, an individual is reminded to strive for truthfulness in their daily actions and conversations, thus growing closer to Allah (God).
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Speaker of Truth" symbolizes The one who speaks the truth, or the one who is pure and sincere.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Kaleema serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of speaker of truth.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Qutaybah, Al-Jamhwa wa Al-'Arab, p. 171 The name Kaleema carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ibn Qutaybah mentions a woman named Kaleema bint Al-Harith Al-Kindi, who was a poetess and a singer in the court of Caliph Al-Ma'mun.

trends: Trending in Muslim baby name searches
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Kaleema remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Khadija Kaleema in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Kaleema, which means "Speaker of Truth". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
